duties.note: Whole route read to a fulfillment conclusion. Misspecification: contamination/variation neighborhoods with nominal-size failure 19/100 and convergence of the location estimate to the population-score root c(F) under arbitrary contamination. Nonidentification: intersecting neighborhoods force maximin power alpha; stipulated normal-component location not identified from the contaminated law (annex 446-455). Failures of routine inference: dependent repeated draws exceed level, inconsistent nonconvex minimizers, two-half-normal limit at cutoff atoms, infinite finite-sample variance, non-unique Fisher minimizer. All 29 linked components covered with written proofs; source variants checked against held Huber 1964/1965.
